title: Automated Logistics Manifest Processing
business: Global logistics firms processing millions of shipping manifests daily.
problem: High-volume document ingestion incurs prohibitive costs when using high-reasoning models for routine data extraction, leading to budget overruns.
solution: Deploy GPT-5.6 Luna to handle high-volume, structured data extraction from manifests, leveraging its optimized architecture for cost-sensitive workloads while maintaining high context window capacity.
steps: Configure the Chat Completions API endpoint to use the gpt-5.6-luna model ID.
Enable prompt caching for recurring manifest template headers to reduce input token costs.
Implement structured_outputs to ensure the model returns consistent JSON schemas for downstream database ingestion.
Set reasoning.effort to low for routine extraction tasks to optimize latency and resource usage.
Monitor token usage per request to ensure manifests remain within the 922,000 input token limit.
outcome: Substantial reduction in operational expenditure for document processing while maintaining the throughput required for real-time logistics tracking.
limitation: The model may exhibit reduced reasoning depth on highly ambiguous or corrupted document scans compared to larger models; verify by comparing output confidence scores against a small validation set of complex manifests.

code.content:
client.chat.completions.create(
  model='gpt-5.6-luna', # Optimized for cost-sensitive workloads
  messages=[{'role': 'user', 'content': manifest_data}],
  reasoning_effort='low', # Minimize resource usage for routine tasks
  response_format={'type': 'json_object'} # Ensure structured_outputs
)
